references.observation: Parses application/json; charset=utf-8 into its JSON OkHttp MediaType field.
Creates RequestBody from that MediaType and JSONObject.toString().
Uses the same MediaType for explicit destination requests.
Application interceptor adds Content-Type application/json; OkHttp body supplies the charset-bearing content type.

change: Only the explicit Android compatibility profile uses JSON content type for HTTP requests. Web encrypted requests retain text/plain, and Web discovery retains application/json.
limitation: This corrects an observed wire-format mismatch; it does not establish the cause of NOT_REGISTERED or prove restored service access. No live request was made.
